## workflow keys
name
on
permissions
env
concurrency
defaults
jobs

## workflow env names
MISE_VERSION

## workflow defaults
run:
  shell: bash

## publish job keys
name
needs
if
strategy
concurrency
runs-on
timeout-minutes
permissions
env
steps

## publish job env
IMAGE: ghcr.io/divbast/frankenphp
APP: ${{ matrix.app }}
MISE_AUTO_INSTALL: "false"

## publish job defaults
(none)

## (no name)
run:
just ci-checkout

## (no name)
run:
just ci-tools

## Decide whether to publish
env: EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
env: GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
run:
# actions/checkout points origin/main at the commit this run built,
# not at main's tip, so a newer published commit would read as one
# that is not on main. The repository is public; no credentials.
git fetch --no-tags --quiet origin +refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main
if ! published=$(.ci/bin/divbast-published-revision "${IMAGE}:${APP}"); then
  echo "::error::Cannot read what ${IMAGE}:${APP} was built from. If the package is private, as its first push can leave it, the owner makes it public in its settings (https://github.com/orgs/divbast/packages/container/frankenphp/settings); nothing in this workflow can."
  exit 1
fi
args=(-event "${EVENT}" -built "${GITHUB_SHA}" -published "${published}")
# A merge's run on the published commit compares nothing, and
# skips: see above.
if [[ -n "${published}" && ( "${EVENT}" == schedule || ( "${EVENT}" == push && "${published}" != "${GITHUB_SHA}" ) ) ]]; then
  # Every architecture, as an anonymous client pulls them
  skopeo copy --all --quiet --src-no-creds "docker://${IMAGE}:${APP}" oci-archive:/tmp/published.tar
  change=$(go run ./cmd/frankenphp-manifest -changes -app "${APP}" -published /tmp/published.tar \
    amd64=/tmp/carriers/amd64/carrier.tar arm64=/tmp/carriers/arm64/carrier.tar)
  args+=(-content-change "${change}" -content-gated)
fi
.ci/bin/divbast-publish-decision "${args[@]}"

## Push both architectures
run:
for arch in amd64 arm64; do
  skopeo copy --all --quiet \
    --digestfile "/tmp/digest-${arch}" \
    --dest-authfile "${HOME}/.docker/config.json" \
    "oci-archive:/tmp/carriers/${arch}/carrier.tar" \
    "docker://${IMAGE}:${APP}-${arch}"
done

## Stage the index
run:
version=$(jq -er .frankenphp /tmp/carriers/amd64/manifest.json)
created=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
docker buildx imagetools create \
  --metadata-file /tmp/index.json \
  --annotation "index:org.opencontainers.image.version=${version}" \
  --annotation "index:org.opencontainers.image.revision=${GITHUB_SHA}" \
  --annotation "index:org.opencontainers.image.created=${created}" \
  --annotation "index:org.opencontainers.image.description=The FrankenPHP binary for divbast's ${APP} image, and the records of how it was built" \
  -t "${IMAGE}:${APP}-staging" \
  "${IMAGE}@$(cat /tmp/digest-amd64)" \
  "${IMAGE}@$(cat /tmp/digest-arm64)"
digest=$(jq -er '."containerimage.descriptor".digest' /tmp/index.json)
echo "digest=${digest}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

## Verify the attestation as apps do
env: DIGEST: ${{ steps.stage.outputs.digest }}
env: GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
run:
if ! skopeo inspect --raw --no-creds "docker://${IMAGE}@${DIGEST}" >"${RUNNER_TEMP}/staged-index.json"; then
  echo "lasting=true" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
  echo "::error::${IMAGE}@${DIGEST} is not anonymously pullable, so the app's tag ${IMAGE}:${APP} didn't move. If the package is private, as its first push can leave it, the owner makes it public in its settings (https://github.com/orgs/divbast/packages/container/frankenphp/settings); nothing in this workflow can."
  exit 1
fi
fetched=$(sha256sum "${RUNNER_TEMP}/staged-index.json")
if [ "sha256:${fetched%% *}" != "${DIGEST}" ]; then
  echo "::error::${IMAGE}@${DIGEST} came back as bytes that hash to sha256:${fetched%% *}."
  exit 1
fi
empty=$(mktemp -d)
for try in 1 2 3; do
  if DOCKER_CONFIG="${empty}" gh attestation verify "${RUNNER_TEMP}/staged-index.json" \
    --repo divbast/frankenphp \
    --signer-workflow divbast/frankenphp/.github/workflows/build.yml@refs/heads/main \
    --source-ref refs/heads/main; then
    exit 0
  fi
  if [ "${try}" -lt 3 ]; then
    sleep 10
  fi
done
echo "::error::gh did not verify the attestation of ${IMAGE}@${DIGEST} in three tries, ten seconds apart."
exit 1

## Check the move keeps the attested digest
env: DIGEST: ${{ steps.stage.outputs.digest }}
run:
docker buildx imagetools create --dry-run -t "${IMAGE}:${APP}" "${IMAGE}@${DIGEST}" >"${RUNNER_TEMP}/promote-index.json"
# The index without buildx's newline, the same on GNU and BSD tools
would=$(printf '%s' "$(<"${RUNNER_TEMP}/promote-index.json")" | sha256sum)
if [ "sha256:${would%% *}" != "${DIGEST}" ]; then
  echo "lasting=true" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
  echo "::error::Moving ${IMAGE}:${APP} would push an index that hashes to sha256:${would%% *}, not the attested ${DIGEST}, so the app's tag didn't move. buildx no longer copies a single index unchanged; a re-run would meet the same."
  exit 1
fi

## Move the tag to the verified index
env: DIGEST: ${{ steps.stage.outputs.digest }}
run:
docker buildx imagetools create -t "${IMAGE}:${APP}" "${IMAGE}@${DIGEST}"

## Check the tag is the pushed index to an anonymous client
env: DIGEST: ${{ steps.stage.outputs.digest }}
run:
if ! pulled=$(skopeo inspect --raw --no-creds "docker://${IMAGE}:${APP}" | sha256sum) ||
  [ "sha256:${pulled%% *}" != "${DIGEST}" ]; then
  echo "::error::${IMAGE}:${APP} is not anonymously pullable as ${DIGEST}. If the package is private, as its first push can leave it, the owner makes it public in its settings (https://github.com/orgs/divbast/packages/container/frankenphp/settings); nothing in this workflow can."
  exit 1
fi
echo "${IMAGE}:${APP} is ${DIGEST} to an anonymous client"

## Say what the failure left
env: LASTING: ${{ steps.verify.outputs.lasting }}${{ steps.keep.outputs.lasting }}
run:
note="The app's tag ${IMAGE}:${APP} didn't move: it still names the index it named before this run."
if [ -z "${LASTING}" ]; then
  note+=" Re-running the failed job publishes within a day of the build, while its carriers are kept; after that, a manual run of build publishes at once, and the next daily or push run does if its content moved."
fi
echo "::error::${note}"
